name: scheduled-deletion
title: Scheduled deletion
description: Banner for something deleted but still recoverable: the final date, days left and a restore button.

props.name: subject
props.description: What is going away, e.g. “The project Spring sale”.

props.name: deletedAt
props.description: When it was marked for deletion.

a11y.text: The banner has role status. Its text gives the date it goes for good and the days left, or That is today. The restore button is a native button, and the clock icon and the progress strip are aria-hidden. The day count refreshes once an hour.
